snippet.title: DustTale: The Genocide's End - ACT 1 RELEASE
snippet.description:
(Apologies for any bad YouTube compression)
After *almost two years* of development, we are proud to show you Act 1 of our Undertale fan-game - *DustTale: The Genocide's End!* [DTGE].

Play the games yourself here: https://gamejolt.com/games/dusttale-last-genocide/513360
Join the official discord server for DTLG and DTGE here: https://discord.gg/dtlg-official-server

*DustTale: The Genocide's End* is the official sequel to *DustTale: Last Genocide.* There is no longer any ULB inspiration behind it, and it is now purely a fresh take on DustTale hardmode, where things aren't as they seem...

Thumbnail by MaxHardcore, Art by Sotwound and Eligos.

Feel free to upload your own playthroughs of this game, but if you want to use any assets such as art, music etc, please credit Team DTLG.

*Team DTLG Members:*
Experiment121 - AU Owner, Musician
MaxHardcore - AU Owner, Programmer, Writer
LucanaDLL - Writer
Sotwound - Artist, Writer
Eligos - Artist
Apricoska - Artist
KaitoMori - Musician
Vesperr - Musician
Fazzy - Musician
Natz - Musician
Reagan H. - Musician
